annotation.title_clean: Law on People's Air Defense No. 49/2024/QH15
annotation.title_en: Law on People's Air Defense No. 49/2024/QH15
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Assembly of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
annotation.summary_en: Vietnam's Law on People's Air Defense (2024, effective 1 July 2025) sets out air defense forces and activities and a licensing regime for unmanned aircraft and other flying vehicles. The regime covers import/export, manufacture, registration, flight permits, pilot licensing, flight suspension, and suppression and seizure. It also amends the Civil Aviation Law.
key_provisions_or_claims: Unmanned aircraft must be registered before operation; flight permits are required except for sub-0.25 kg recreational flights in permitted areas.
Manufacture, repair, and trade require certificates of eligibility from the Ministry of National Defense, and products must meet its standards.
Import and export of unmanned aircraft and related equipment require licences from the defense, public security, or trade ministries.
Operators must be 18 or older and hold a flight control licence; foreign operators need a Vietnamese guarantor.
Authorities may suspend flights and suppress or temporarily seize non-compliant drones; the law takes effect 1 July 2025.
